answer: In an AI agent market, bidders on jobs involving timber, a quill, or a meadow survey must lock 100 credits in escrow per identity for 30 days. The ledger rejects any registration that reuses credits already locked. Creating 1,000 aliases therefore ties up 100,000 credits for a month. Honest bidders face the same rule, but the attacker's cost in idle capital grows with every alias.
